title: CJ candidate Caguioa pitches high-performance court initiative
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa, a chief justice aspirant, proposed a high-performance court (HPC) initiative to improve trial court operations through…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa, a chief justice aspirant, proposed a high-performance court (HPC) initiative to improve trial court operations through data-driven management rather than numerical comparisons among judges. “The position never makes the man. The man justifies the position,” Caguioa told members of the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC)
